title: Feature-edge detection and cross-field alignment to creases
description: First half of 'feature aligned patches for the quad layout'. Add a `select_feature_edges` node producing a per-edge BoolField (dihedral angle above `angle_degrees`, optional min chain length) in the same shape mark_edges/EdgeMarks already use, and a SharpEdgeConstraint ConstraintSource next to CurvatureConstraints so the cross field is pinned parallel to selected edges (KCP*13 alignment constraints; LCK21a section on feature constraints). The cross-field node gains an optional `feature_edges` BOOLEAN input. Feature edges then flow downstream as a BoolField selection (standing ruling: cone points and feature edges are their own values, never sub-components of a UV field). PATCH-89 (Lyon section 4.4 feature lines and boundary alignment in the motorcycle graph) is the downstream half -- forcing layout arcs onto the feature curves -- and is blocked by this ticket; do not re-create it under CRAW.
definition-of-done: 1. `select_feature_edges` node registered, documented in socketDocs, catalog regenerated. 2. `cross_field` accepts feature_edges and the resulting field is parallel to every selected edge within 2 degrees on a beveled-cube fixture. 3. CrossFieldExaminationScene shows selected edges via setFeatureEdgeOverlay and the aligned field. 4. Unit test on the beveled-cube fixture asserts alignment; no mesh files in the unit suite. 5. Fertility baseline unchanged when no feature edges are supplied. 6. Build checkstyle-green.
testing-plan: 1. Unit: beveled cube (GridMeshNode-built) -> select_feature_edges at 30 degrees selects exactly the 12 crease chains. 2. Unit: cross field with those constraints has per-face direction within 2 degrees of the adjacent crease. 3. run-scene cross-field scene on a decimation-free crawfish scan (once CRAW-2 lands) or on rockerarm; screenshot shows arcs of the field following ridges. 4. Regression: quad-layout scene on fertility reproduces the baseline counts.
